title: Seeded 22-Layer Asymmetric Stack with Expanded Thickness Bounds
scientific_hypothesis: Initializing thickness optimization from the best previous candidate (opt_22l_tio2_sio2_dualband_45deg____df990e3f65dc) with expanded perturbation bounds will enable convergence beyond 0.9251 by exploring configuration space around the discovered asymmetric chirp pattern.
design_principle: Preserve the asymmetric thickness distribution discovered in prior iteration (thin high-index bands around layers 8-10, thick low-index bands around layers 14-16) while allowing independent thickness adjustment across all 22 layers with ±40 nm bounds instead of ±20 nm.
proposed_topology: 22 finite layers: TiO2-SiO2-TiO2-SiO2-TiO2-SiO2-TiO2-SiO2-TiO2-SiO2-TiO2-SiO2-TiO2-SiO2-TiO2-SiO2-TiO2-SiO2-TiO2-SiO2-TiO2-SiO2 on fused silica substrate, air incident medium
design_variables: 22 layer thicknesses (nm), each independently optimizable with bounds 30-250 nm
manufacturing_considerations: thickness bounds 30-250 nm compatible with standard deposition control
theory_basis: Quarter-wave baseline initialization refined by needle optimization for multi-wavelength targets
Asymmetric chirp patterns enable broader bandwidth than symmetric quarter-wave stacks
expected_advantages: Expanded bounds allow escape from local optimum found at 0.9251
Seeded initialization preserves beneficial asymmetric pattern from prior iteration
known_risks: Wider bounds may increase optimization iterations needed for convergence
May converge to similar local optimum if configuration space is constrained by physics
execution_request_english: Optimize a 22-layer TiO2/SiO2 dielectric stack on fused silica substrate at 45 degrees incidence. Layer sequence: TiO2-SiO2 repeated 11 times (22 finite layers total). Initialize thicknesses from candidate opt_22l_tio2_sio2_dualband_45deg____df990e3f65dc thickness profile [186.73, 122.66, 179.91, 193.56, 186.67, 89.69, 207.37, 111.87, 42.83, 79.15, 186.38, 63.29, 38.87, 104.96, 244.49, 67.10, 62.04, 93.08, 199.86, 243.32, 172.36, 62.45] nm. Allow each layer thickness to vary independently within bounds 30-250 nm. Optimize for maximum mean reflectance in 450-650 nm band and maximum mean transmittance in 700-1000 nm band. Use gradient-based thickness optimizer with population seeding from the provided profile. Canonical user controls: wavelength intervals 450-650 nm, 700-1000 nm. soft objectives: high reflectance in 450-650 nm; high transmittance in 700-1000 nm; minimized crosstalk between bands. behaviors to suppress or avoid: transmittance in 450-650 nm; reflectance in 700-1000 nm. manufacturing constraints: maximum 24 layers.
revision_reason: Continues route_03 optimization with expanded thickness bounds (±40 nm vs previous ±20 nm) and seeded initialization from best prior candidate to explore configuration space around discovered asymmetric chirp pattern.
